name: Tokyo Dark Matter Search
notes: external.inspire_experiment is null: INSPIRE was not consulted (its rate budget belongs to the supervised importer).

Named in its papers 'the Tokyo group' and 'Tokyo dark matter search programme' (earlier title: 'First Results of Tokyo Dark Matter Search with a Lithium Fluoride Bolometer', arXiv:hep-ex/9709019); no collaboration name exists, so no collaboration record is created. Authors: University of Tokyo (Department of Physics, RESCEU, ICEPP) and University of Tsukuba.

Earlier phases of the same programme ran outside the Atlas: a 21 g LiF bolometer in a surface laboratory (arXiv:hep-ex/9709019) and eight 21 g LiF absorbers for about ten days in the Nokogiriyama underground cell (about 15 m.w.e.; arXiv:hep-ex/9904034). They are not recorded as intervals or results because neither site is in the Atlas.

The NaF paper states that its limits 'excluded the parameter space complementary to the results obtained by NaI detectors of UKDMC experiment'; a complementary lineage row with the UKDMC NaI experiment (experiment:naiad) would live on experiment:naiad (lexicographically smaller id) and is listed for the integrator.
Latest run reported is the NaF measurement of December 2002 - January 2003; the end is recorded as 'completed' with low confidence and no end date.

physics_goals.quote: aiming for the direct detection of WIMPs via spin-dependent interaction
physics_goals.value: Direct detection of WIMPs through spin-dependent interaction (19F and 23Na targets)

summary.plain: A University of Tokyo experiment in the Kamioka mine, Japan, that used small fluoride crystals (lithium fluoride, then sodium fluoride) cooled to near absolute zero to look for dark matter particles that interact through nuclear spin, and set limits on their couplings.
summary.technical: Arrays of eight LiF (168 g) or NaF (176 g) bolometers with NTD-Ge thermistors in a dilution refrigerator below 10 mK, 2700 m.w.e., in a laboratory excavated near Super-Kamiokande (Mozumi mine). Spin-dependent WIMP searches: 4.1 kg d of LiF (2001-2002) and 3.38 kg d of NaF (2002-2003) give limits in the a_p-a_n plane, excluding much of the UKDMC-allowed region.
